sentences.text:
The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Chutia P.S. Case No.75 of 2023, S.T. Case No.552 of 2023, for the offences registered under Sections 365/313/314 of the Indian Penal Code and chargesheet submitted under Sections 364, 376, 313, 302 & 201/34 of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the court of Shri Dinesh Kumar, learned Additional Judicial Commissioner-XV at Ranchi.
On 13.02.2023, daughter of the informant left her house with this petitioner.
Case under Sections 365, 313 and 314 of the Indian Penal Code was instituted against him.

Case diary earlier called for has been received and from perusal of which, it appears that the petitioner has confessed his guilt that he was having illicit relationship with her, due to which, she became pregnant and thereafter, she committed suicide.
Petitioner burnt her dead body and on his confession, hair particles of the deceased were recovered.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that even assuming the confession of the petitioner to be true, a case under Section 201 of the Indian Penal Code will be made out, which is bailable in nature.
It was further submitted that similarly situated co-accused person has been granted bail by this Court earlier.
